title: Tandoori Chicken Tikka
description: A classic Indian dish made by marinating chicken in yogurt and spices, then grilling to perfection. Serve with naan bread or basmati rice.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until the chicken is well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle cilantro over the top of the chicken and serve.
